headline: Binance Intake Falls To 73.2 Million Dollars From 194.0 Million
narrative: Binance clean-asset intake fell to 73.2 million dollars from 194.0 million dollars. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitstamp intake stands at 296.2 million dollars inside a 299.6 million dollar intake across 79 exchanges, equal to 0.1116 percent of the 268.4 billion dollars held on those venues, while Bitfinex sent out 62.5 million dollars.
author: jordan
